text:
Frankfurt’s median asking rent stands at 17.5 €/m², up 3.2 % YoY and 24.4 % over five years, making it the second‑most expensive market among 37 cities. The 25‑day average time on market and a 31 % share of listings let within a week signal a tight market, while the vacancy rate is only 1.9 %.

Asking rents sit 65 % above the 2022 existing‑rent level of 10.58 €/m², pushing a typical 60 m² unit to 1 050 €/month and creating a rent‑burden of 21.4 % for two residents. Population growth of 3.3 % over five years adds pressure to affordability.

The model estimate forecasts the median asking rent at 18.52 €/m² in 12 months, with a range of 18.0 – 18.96 €/m², implying a 5.8 % increase.
